details: ETHFI fell over 3% as Spartan Group moved vested tokens to Coinbase Prime, signaling potential selling. This, coupled with a soft ETH backdrop and profit-taking after a strong July, contributed to the decline. The move also aligns with a broader risk-off sentiment in altcoins.
title: Ether.fi (ETHFI) Drops as Unlock-Linked Sell Pressure Rises

details: AVAX saw a price move supported by Kenya's decision to use the Avalanche network to anchor over 30 million national academic credentials. This marks one of Avalanche's largest public sector deployments, enhancing its real-world utility beyond DeFi.
title: Avalanche (AVAX) Gets Boost from Kenya's Academic Credential Adoption

details: DOT rose almost 4%, driven by strong narratives around Polkadot 2.0, increased ecosystem activity, and technical breakouts. This outperformance occurred while the broader crypto market saw a smaller rise, indicating DOT-specific drivers.
title: Polkadot (DOT) Surges on Polkadot 2.0 Focus, Ecosystem Activity

details: ZEC surged after announcements of new payment integrations, allowing its use for anonymous eSIM purchases, real estate, and flights. This expands Zcash's real-world utility and aligns with a bullish technical setup.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Rises Following New Payment Integrations for Real-World Use

details: Blackrock launched two new tokenized money market products, BSTBL and BRSRV, aimed at institutional investors and stablecoin issuers. These funds combine blockchain-based ownership records with portfolios of cash and short-term U.S. government debt, enhancing stablecoin reserve management.
title: Blackrock Introduces Tokenized Money Market Funds for Stablecoin Issuers

details: The Coldcard hardware wallet exploit has grown to approximately $116 million across four waves, with 1,816 BTC stolen from over 5,200 addresses. Coinkite urged users to move funds immediately due to a 2021 firmware flaw. This incident has caused security concerns and contributed to some selling pressure in Bitcoin.
title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Hack Soars to $116 Million, Funds Draining
